title: Satori business app connector
description: Writes a connector of the kit's own into connectors/<package>-connectors-config.xml, beside the bundle: the fields one record's key reads from another system, for an external card. No address and no credential is written: each is a server setting.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.

id.description: The connector's id, which an external card names: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter, such as acme.policyPayments. Its settings are named after it.

type.description: The document types it reads a key from, separated by commas, 1 to 20, and the only ones its card shows anything on.

key.description: The property of each type that holds the key, <prefix>:<name>, such as claim:number: one value, put into the path.

path.description: Where on the other system, from /, with {key} once, such as /claims/{key}: letters, digits, '/', '.', '_', '~' and '-' besides, and no query.

fields.description: What it returns, separated by commas, 1 to 50, each <name> or <name>=<JSON pointer into the answer>, such as paidAmount=/payment/amount. The pointer is /<name> by default.

permission.description: The Nuxeo permission a person needs on the record for the card to read it. Defaults to Read.

credential.description: Send a token, from the server property nuxeo.agentic.connectors.<id>.token, else the environment variable NUXEO_CONNECTOR_<ID>_TOKEN, in header. The token itself is never written here.

header.description: With credential: the header the token goes in, letters, digits and '-'. Defaults to Authorization. Not one that changes where or how the request goes, such as Host, Cookie, Accept, Content-Type or Proxy-*, which the add-on refuses.

prefix.description: With credential: what goes before the token, at most 32 printable characters. Defaults to 'Bearer '.

connectTimeout.description: The connection's limit, 100 to 10000 ms. The add-on's default, 2000, otherwise.

timeout.description: The whole call's limit, 100 to 30000 ms. The add-on's default, 5000, otherwise.

maxBytes.description: The largest answer it reads, 1024 to 1048576. The add-on's default, 262144, otherwise.

maxConcurrent.description: The calls running at once, 1 to 64. The add-on's default, 8, otherwise.

model.description: The content model the types and the key are held to. Defaults to the package's own content-model.json, when it has one; with neither, they are not checked.

remove.description: Take the connector out, and the file with it when it is the last. Given alone.

force.description: Write the connector again when the file has it already.
